description.fun: A robot that fuses Gardevoir and Gallade, Mega forms included, into one knightly warrior. It can detach the blades from its arms and join them into a double-ended weapon, or keep them on and spin its upper half independently of its legs. A paranormal magazine claimed a mad scientist built it while trying to make the most powerful psychic Pokémon. It's the only Paradox Pokémon based on two Pokémon.
description.guide: A Fairy and Fighting-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Violet, said to be either a future relative of Gardevoir and Gallade or a version of them from a parallel timeline. It fights with detachable arm blades, and its counterpart is Roaring Moon.
description.tagline: Gardevoir and Gallade fused into one robot knight
